newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Krka surges on debut.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Krka surges on debut.

text.p: Slovenian drug producer Krka made its debut on the over-the-counter market on Monday at 28,400 tolars, well above the 17,000 to 20,000 tolars it had been trading at on the grey market last week.
"Krka is among Slovenia's largest and most profitable companies and has already attracted a lot of interest from both foreign and domestic investors," one broker said.
"But it's opened very high," the broker said, adding it would likely fall prey to profit-taking.
By 0900 GMT, Krka had eased back to 26,000 tolars.
Krka's spectacular debut also triggered buying of rival Lek, which surged 4.2 percent to drive the blue-chip SBI index to an all-time high of 1,665.3 points for the fourth trading session in a row.
